items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 37:1
items.html: Because the letters of Tvuna [תבונה] are son [בן] and daughter [בת], which is on account of her clothing in ZON, who are her son and her daughter. (Page 912, Sub Header, “and this”).
